subject: Partnership idea for [their work]
body:
Hi [First name],

I’m reaching out from VedicHour. I read [their work] and thought your audience might appreciate a calm, evidence-aware way to explore timing without certainty or outcome promises.

VedicHour rates all 18 planetary hours (horas) in plain English, using Swiss Ephemeris + Lahiri ayanamsa. We’d like to offer you a free Pro account, a custom reader code like PARTNERNAME10, and a revenue share for paid reports your readers choose to buy.

If useful, I can send a simple partner brief and sample report.

Your Life, Decoded Hour by Hour.

To opt out, reply “unsubscribe”; [Physical address].
linter_reason: Calm, educational tone; explicitly avoids certainty/outcome promises; aligns with timing awareness.
